summary: Figure 5b reports 23 semaglutide-versus-vehicle discoveries as a count, without gene identifiers. The registered GLP-1-versus-vehicle edgeR table has zero discoveries at FDR < 0.05. The published gene-level panels use a different contrast or a different cohort, so gene-level concordance remains unassessed.

manualReview.summary: GEO confirms the registered arms. The linked author result gives only a discovery count for monoagonist versus vehicle.
manualReview.note: GSE245727 has six hypothalamic GLP-1 and six vehicle libraries in the registered contrast. The Figure 5 code reads the same 0149 library series and estimates peptide minus vehicle. The paper calls the monoagonist semaglutide. Figure 5b shows 18 semaglutide-only discoveries and five shared with the conjugate. Figures 5c and 5e use conjugate minus semaglutide. Figure 3f uses a separate eight-mouse-per-arm experiment. The GEO files contain per-library featureCounts counts. The paper, supplements and author code provided no gene identifiers, effects or individual test statistics for the Figure 5b monoagonist-versus-vehicle set.
reviewFlags: The authors' 0149 sample metadata file is referenced by the code but was absent from the public repository. The link to semaglutide rests on library identifiers, the Figure 5 analysis and the paper's treatment labels.
The original input assembly has no committed source checksum manifest. The current GEO archive and its members are hashed in the continued evidence.

verificationReview.reason: The available author result for the registered arms is a Venn count. It gives 23 DESeq2 discoveries at BH-adjusted P < 0.05, while the registered edgeR-QL table gives zero at FDR < 0.05. The count supplies no gene identifiers or effects. The gene-labelled panels cover another cohort or use the conjugate as a treatment arm.
verificationReview.nextStep: To compare genes, obtain the Figure 5 DEGs.peptide table for condition_peptide_vs_vehicle with gene identifiers, log2 fold changes, raw P and adjusted P, together with the 0149 sample-to-treatment key used in jona-seq2_meta.csv.
